Command: Work Out Your Salvation with Fear and Trembling
Summary: Paul's working-out command: work out your own salvation with fear and trembling, for it is God who works in you both to will and to do.
Commandment: Work out your own salvation with fear and trembling. For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
Application: The paradox is the point: human working-out rests on divine working-in. Fear and trembling are reverence before a holy God, not anxiety about whether grace will hold.
Purpose: Scripture's own reason: 'for it is God which worketh in you' (Philippians 2:13).
